name: Environment Canada MSC GeoMet-OGC-API: Air Quality Health Index (AQHI) observations
short: Hourly AQHI readings at about 124 Canadian locations as GeoJSON via OGC API Features. No key; ECCC open licence.
summary: Environment and Climate Change Canada's MSC GeoMet-OGC-API at api.weather.gc.ca serves many collections as GeoJSON (hydrometric stations, climate, weather and more; the collection index answered 200). aqhi-observations-realtime holds hourly AQHI values per community with location id, bilingual name, observation_datetime and aqhi (for example Corner Brook 1.51 at 2026-11-06T04:00Z). The collection reported 7853 items on 2026-11-07; latest=true returned 124 current locations and sortby=-observation_datetime gave a newest stamp of 2026-11-07T18:00Z. aqhi-forecasts-realtime offers forecasts. Default ordering is oldest first, so use latest=true or sortby.

coverage.notes: About 124 current locations across Canada; the index lists many other collections not called here.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-07: newest observation_datetime 2026-11-07T18:00:00Z at about 18:20 UTC.

latency.notes: latest=true returns one current value per station.

licensing.summary: Environment and Climate Change Canada Data Services End-use Licence v2.1.1: worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, non-exclusive licence to use the information including for commercial purposes; copy, modify, publish, distribute for any lawful purpose; you must acknowledge the source using the attribution statement given. Weather alerts must not be altered in content or intent. AI training is not separately addressed.

time.unknown: Report time is the provider's own stamp.

location.unknown: Fixed station or event coordinates; not independently checked.

content.unknown: AQHI is a derived index, not raw pollutant concentrations.
content.method: Index computed from monitoring-network pollutant readings; observation_type shows original or corrected.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments or official analysis, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no camera frames in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

api.rate_limits: No numeric limit stated on the pages read; ECCC asks heavy users to use the MSC Datamart.
api.notes: OGC API Features; GeoJSON, JSON-LD and HTML. Bilingual field names (en and fr).

sources.claim: Live keyless GET 2026-11-07: AQHI observations GeoJSON, 7853 items, newest 2026-11-07T18:00Z
